overview: Euclid DR1 dominates: a five-model plus citizen-science pipeline released 15,072 strong-lens candidates over 2000 deg2. The period also produced shared resources — the COSMIO cross-survey imputation benchmark, the FAIR Universe weak-lensing uncertainty challenge, Survey of Surveys DR3 (10.13 million homogenised stars) and differentiable JAX/PyTorch galpy backends. Methods centred on simulation-based inference and neural surrogates (normalizing flows for N(z), Fourier neural operators for MHD turbulence, equivariant spherical operators), unified gravitational-wave waveform networks and neural posterior estimation, plus LLM pipelines extracting dark-matter models, galaxy discussions and multi-agent high-energy analyses.
themes: Gravitational-wave waveform emulation and posterior estimation
Foundation-model interpretability and LLM agent pipelines
